name: Tidal Masjid
summary: A tall stepped mosque rises directly from a flowing blue waterline, balanced around one central axis.
why: The square minaret, faceted dome, doorway, and central water crest share x=54. The wave is joined to the hall along its foundation and its curved outer contour stays visible in monochrome.
risk: The water is intentionally simplified to one flowing band. At 24px it reads as a soft base beneath the vertical mosque.
sub1: One stepped minaret anchors the entire composition
sub2: A flowing waterline joins the building at its base
theme: Still water beneath a rising mosque
reasonToChoose: You want a distinctive geometric mosque whose composition remains coherent without color.
